Little Acorns Nursery

Dear families,

The nursery will be closed on Friday 31 October for staff training.

Our Christmas party for the children is on Wednesday 17 December, 10am-12pm. Parents are welcome to join us from 11:30am for mince pies.

The last day before Christmas is Friday 19 December and we reopen on Monday 5 January 2027.

Please let us know by 1 December if your child has any allergies.

Many thanks,
The Little Acorns team
